summary: Two findings after reading all 39 pages of the v1 source and the complete accepted extraction: one high-severity failure to propagate the existing G2 compact-part counterexample to the still-unrestricted Theorem 8.5 exceptional list, and one medium-severity missing arithmetic supplier for Theorem 4.2 in the local representation route. The published revision was unavailable for collation. No claim that the global automorphic theorems are false.

findings.where: research/blueprint/papers/PAPER-CIUBOTARU-HARRIS-26.result.json item extraneous-exceptional and route 2 SmoothRepresentationsPartIIUnitarySpherical; corresponding reader endpoint and route 3 uses of Theorem 8.5
findings.claim: The exceptional extraneous-orbit list remains false with its stated geometricity and connected-center hypotheses. The extraction restricts the generic local tests after E11 but still says no extraneous points occur for G2 and asks route 2 to finish the unrestricted Theorem 8.5. The existing E11 parameter also satisfies full arithmetic geometricity and lies in CS(G2,0) with nonzero real part.
findings.evidence: Ciubotaru–Harris v1, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2311.15300v1, Definition 2.5 p.7, equation (8.1) p.27, Definitions 8.4/Theorem 8.5 p.28 and Remark 8.7 p.30: 'there are no extraneous points for G2 or E6'. For short/long dual simple roots alpha1,alpha2, take (a alpha1+b alpha2)(s)=(-1)^a q^(b/2). The positive-root values are -1,sqrt(q),-sqrt(q),sqrt(q),-sqrt(q),-q. Kato Theorem 2.2 and the irreducible hermitian deformation from t=0 to 1 verify E11's unitary principal series. Every G2 weight is an integral root combination, so every eigenvalue is a Weil number of integer weight. Ad(s) has no q-eigenvalue, so the open nilpotent orbit defining its stratum is zero. Its central point is 0 but its real part is omega2/2. G2 has connected trivial center. This is the additional consequence not recorded in E11's affected locators; the report gives the full root and stabilizer calculation.
findings.fix: Propagate E11 to Theorem 8.5/Remark 8.7 and replace the unrestricted exceptional endpoint, route and reader together. Retain a precisely restricted real/central-compact classification; mark the arbitrary compact-part classification as requiring a centralizer-of-s_c analysis and a new exhaustive proof. Audit the Sp/Spin/E8 list interfaces as well. Extend E11 or add a linked v1 source issue, add the fully geometric G2 zero-orbit witness as a regression case, and explicitly gate global uses of this list while preserving the existing stratum-recognition gap. Do not assert a global counterexample or repair exhaustiveness simply by adding one G2 point.

findings.claim: Theorem 4.2 is assigned to the local unitary-spherical extension without its arithmetic suppliers. Its brief imports local induction, temperedness, unitary topology, nilpotent orbits and local parameters, but neither discrete-series globalization nor the cusp coefficient/geometricity interface. The item's source note does not assign this supplier. Several arithmetic ingredients are instead owned by the global Part II, which already consumes the local extension; importing that entire consumer back would give a two-way proposed dependency.
findings.evidence: Ciubotaru–Harris v1 §4.1 pp.11–12 proves the number-field-model claim by Beuzart-Plessis's globalization appendix to GHS and §3.1 cusp coefficients, then uses geometricity, embedding-independent exponent absolute values and Casselman's criterion. Item galois-discrete-series records the GHS attribution and E10 but route 2 lists no arithmetic supplier. FA.6 owns coefficient models; geometric-discrete-series, ghs-discrete-series-purity and galois-temperedness are routed to GlobalShtukasPartIIRamanujanArthur, whose brief explicitly consumes UnitarySpherical. The proposed GHS SupercuspidalParameters route is held for revision and its review verdict is revise, so it cannot be treated as an already accepted proof. This finding is about the missing route contract, not a rediscovery of E10 or a claimed existing live-stage cycle.
